headword: {正真正銘|しょうしんしょうめい}
reading: しょうしんしょうめい

definitions.gloss: genuine; authentic; undeniable; the real deal
definitions.explanation: Emphasizes that something is absolutely genuine and beyond any doubt. A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) used for strong emphasis.

notes:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character idiom) meaning "absolutely genuine" or "the real deal." Literally, both {正真|しょうしん} and {正銘|しょうめい} mean "genuine" — doubling for emphatic force.

Functions as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective: {正真正銘|しょうしんしょうめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun.
